Contact.title: Contact
Contact.description: Send the Elaka360 team a question, feedback or an error in the information.
Contact.emergency: Do not use this form in an emergency. For police, fire service or ambulance, call {number}.
Contact.formIntro: Questions, feedback, errors in the information or offers of collaboration — write to us with this form.

accuracy.a: Every published piece of information shows its source and evidence level. So far, the published information is “{label}” — that is, taken from sources such as Wikipedia, census compilations or newspapers, not officially verified. So before an important decision, check with the government office or institution concerned. See the <policy>data & verification policy</policy> for details.

report.q: How do I report an error?
report.a: Use this form to tell us which page is wrong and how, and if possible give a link to a source for the correct information (for example a government website or gazette). No correction is published without a source; changes reach the site only after review.

add.q: How do I add a new place or institution?
add.a: After signing in, you can send a suggestion from the <contribute>Add information</contribute> page. The suggestion is reviewed and published only after its source has been checked. Read the rules in the <guidelines>contribution guidelines</guidelines>.

data.q: How is the information I send used?
data.a: The subject, message and (optional) email you give in this form are stored only to deal with and reply to your message. Details are in the <privacy>privacy policy</privacy>.

About.title: About us
About.description: What Elaka360 is, where its information comes from, what is published and what is planned.
About.mission1: Elaka360’s aim is simple: that people in Bangladesh can find reliable information about their own area — administrative areas, institutions, services and emergency numbers — in one place, in Bangla, and with sources.
About.mission2: We believe it matters to show the source next to the information. So every published piece of information says where it was taken from, and we do not publish information that has not yet been checked.
About.independent: Elaka360 is an independent initiative. It is not part of the Government of Bangladesh or any government agency, and no government agency has endorsed it.
About.howIntro: Every piece of information has an evidence level. On the site they are labelled like this:
About.howSourced: Only {official} or {secondary} information whose source is named is shown as “Sourced”. Community data and not-yet-verified information are shown too, but every such page carries a “Not verified” warning.
About.howSecondary: So far, all sourced information comes from secondary sources — such as Wikipedia, the citypopulation.de compilation of the BBS Census 2022, and newspapers. No information has been officially verified yet.
About.howCommunity: The administrative levels below the district (upazilas, unions) come from a community dataset. Until they have been checked against the official list, most of them are shown as “Not verified”.
About.howPilot: Elaka360 is currently in the Rajshahi pilot phase: information on institutions and places is for now limited to a few places in Rajshahi District.
About.planIntro: The work below is in our plans. These are not promises, and there is no fixed schedule.
About.plan1: Check the lists of upazilas and unions against official sources, step by step.
About.plan2: Add information on institutions and services in districts beyond Rajshahi.
About.plan3: Review and publish users’ corrections and suggestions for new places.

Guidelines.title: Contribution guidelines
Guidelines.description: Rules for giving information, photos and reviews on Elaka360 — what is accepted and what is rejected.
Guidelines.intro: The information, photos and reviews you give help others. To keep the information reliable for everyone, please follow the rules below.

source.title: Cite a source
source.body: Give a verifiable source with new information or a correction — for example a link to a government website, a gazette, the institution’s own website or a reliable newspaper. Search engine result pages are not accepted as sources.

personal.title: No personal information
personal.body: Do not give private individuals’ personal phone numbers, home addresses, identity document details or photos. An institution’s public contact details may be given.

spam.title: No advertising or spam
spam.body: Promotional text, irrelevant links, submitting the same information again and again, or fake reviews of your own business are not accepted.

photos.title: Your own photos
photos.body: Only give photos that you took yourself or have permission to use. If people’s faces are clearly visible, their consent is required.

respect.title: Be respectful in reviews
respect.body: Write honestly about your own experience. Abuse, threats, hateful or discriminatory remarks, and attacks on a specific staff member by name are not allowed.

rejected.r1: Information without a source, or that cannot be verified
rejected.r2: Numbers or statistics based on guesses or hearsay
rejected.r3: Anyone’s personal information, or photos taken without permission
rejected.r5: Text or photos copied from others
rejected.r7: Falsely presenting yourself as a government representative or an official of an institution

Guidelines.after1: A reviewer looks at suggestions for new places and corrections. A suggestion may be approved, returned for changes, or rejected; you can see the status of each suggestion on your profile. Information is published on the site only after its source has been checked — how, is described in the <link>data & verification policy</link>.
Guidelines.after2: Reviews are published as soon as they are submitted. Anyone can report a review that breaks the rules, and it may be removed after review.
Guidelines.after3: Repeatedly breaking the rules may lead to an account being limited or closed.

Privacy.title: Privacy policy
Privacy.description: What information Elaka360 collects, why, how long it is kept and how to ask for it to be deleted.
Privacy.intro: This page explains in plain language what information about you Elaka360 keeps, and why. The site is new and some things have not been decided yet — they are stated openly here.

phone.why: For signing in. A one-time code is sent to the number by SMS. An SMS provider will be used to send the code; it has not been finalised yet. To prevent abuse, the IP address at the time the code was requested is kept with the code record.

profile.why: Your name, an optional home area and who can see your profile — you set these yourself. Your name may be shown next to your reviews and contributions.

session.why: To keep you signed in, a session record is kept, together with your browser or app identifier (user agent). Signing out ends that session.

contributions.why: New places, corrections, reviews and their review history are kept so that the source of information and its changes can be traced. Reviews are published to everyone as soon as they are submitted; a contribution’s information reaches the site once it is approved in review.

saved.why: The places or areas you save are kept in your account so you can see them later.

contact.why: The subject, message and, if you give it, your email address — only to deal with and reply to your message.

Privacy.browseFree: You can browse the site without signing in; then none of the account information above is created.

notStored.nearMe: “Near me”: with your permission, your browser shares your location, and it is used only to find nearby places. Your location is not stored in our database.
notStored.logs: Server logs: the server logs the page or address part (path), time and result of each request, but query strings (such as search terms or location coordinates) are not logged.
notStored.cache: Offline cache: some general pages and data of the site may be stored in your device’s browser for offline viewing. Profile, saved lists, sign-in and contribution pages are not stored this way.
notStored.map: Map: map tiles come from a third-party map service, so while you view the map your browser communicates with that service directly.

Privacy.retention1: How long each kind of information will be kept is still to be decided. Once specific periods are set, they will be written on this page.
Privacy.retention2: Sign-in codes stop working after a short time, but how long code records will be kept is also still to be decided.
Privacy.deletion1: While signed in, you can send a request to delete your account from the <link>profile</link> page, and you can cancel the request before it has been processed. Requests are processed by hand by members of the Elaka360 team.
Privacy.deletion2: For any other questions, use the <link>contact form</link>.
Privacy.legal: How our practices fit the applicable rules on data protection in Bangladesh is currently being reviewed. This policy may change as a result; if it does, this page will be updated.

Terms.title: Terms of use
Terms.description: Terms for using Elaka360: the nature of the information, user content, moderation and the relationship with the government.
Terms.intro: By using Elaka360 you accept the terms below. They are written in plain language.
Terms.s1p1: The site’s information is taken from the sources named and provided “as is”. We try to keep the information correct, but we cannot guarantee that any information is complete, accurate or up to date. The source and evidence level of each piece of information are explained in the <link>data & verification policy</link>.
Terms.s1p2: Before an important decision — for example about medical care, legal matters, government services, travel or money — check the information against the official source of the government office or institution concerned.
Terms.s1p3: In an emergency, do not wait for information on the site — call 999 directly.
Terms.s2p1: Elaka360 is an independent initiative. It is not part of any ministry, office or agency of the Government of Bangladesh, does not act on their behalf, and is not endorsed by them. A government institution’s name or number appearing on the site only provides information; it does not mean any partnership.
Terms.s3intro: When you submit a review, photo, new place or correction, you confirm that:
Terms.s3li1: the information is true to the best of your knowledge and, where applicable, you have cited a source;
Terms.s3li2: you own the rights to the photo or text, or have permission to use it;
Terms.s3li3: it contains no one’s personal information, harassment, hate speech, advertising or anything illegal.
Terms.s3p2: You give Elaka360 permission to show, edit and store the content you submit on the site. Detailed rules are in the <link>contribution guidelines</link>.
Terms.s4p1: New places and corrections are published only after review. Reviews are published immediately, but anyone can report an inappropriate review. If the guidelines are not followed we may edit, hide or delete content, and if the rules are broken repeatedly we may limit or close the account.
Terms.s5li1: putting unusual load on the site or the API, or trying to get around security measures;
Terms.s5li2: opening or using an account in someone else’s name;
Terms.s6p1: The site and these terms may change over time. If they change, this page will be updated.
Terms.s6p2: To learn how personal information is used, see the <privacy>privacy policy</privacy>. If you have questions, <contact>contact us</contact>.

DataPolicy.title: Data & verification policy
DataPolicy.description: Evidence levels of information on Elaka360, what is published, the list of sources, how corrections work and known gaps.
DataPolicy.intro: The rules below decide which information Elaka360 shows and which it does not. The key point: next to every piece of information it says which source it came from and whether it has been verified.
DataPolicy.verifiedWord: The word “verified” is used only for officially verified information. So far, no information has reached this level.
DataPolicy.diffIntro: A piece of information counts as “Sourced” (publishable) only when:
DataPolicy.diffLi2: the name of the source it was taken from (and a link where possible) is recorded.
DataPolicy.diffRest: The rest of the information is shown too, so that you can find your own area and point out errors. But every such page carries a “Not verified” warning at the top, and search engines are not allowed to index it. Emergency hotlines are never shown without a source, and any future Open Data export will contain only sourced information. These rules are enforced at the database level.
DataPolicy.whyTitle: Why most upazilas and unions are “Not verified”
DataPolicy.why1: The lists of divisions, districts and city corporations were checked against secondary sources and published. But the full list of the levels below the district (upazilas, unions) came from a community dataset, in which some new upazilas and unions are missing or in the wrong place. Until they have been checked against the official list, they are shown as “Not verified”.
DataPolicy.why2: Exceptions: as part of the Rajshahi pilot, the upazilas of Rajshahi District, and a few areas for which a separate source was found, are sourced.
DataPolicy.population: Population figures are taken from the BBS Census 2022 (via the citypopulation.de compilation), but not on the same basis at every level: adjusted figures are used for divisions and districts, and enumerated figures for the upazilas of Rajshahi District. So the upazila figures may not add up exactly to the district total.
DataPolicy.corrections1: If you see an error, tell us through the <contact>contact form</contact>, or sign in and send a <contribute>correction</contribute> — with a source for the correct information.
DataPolicy.corrections2: A reviewer on the Elaka360 team looks at the source and approves the suggestion, asks for changes or rejects it.
DataPolicy.corrections3: If approved, the information is updated and the new source is shown with it. A record of changes is kept.
DataPolicy.correctionsMore: See the detailed rules in the <link>contribution guidelines</link>.
